name: OW4-J1-every-peak-left-freely
new: if (leaving || climateAt(ax, ay) === TV_MOUNTAIN_CLIMATE) return false;
note: OW3 J5's law back: every step out of ANY Mountain pixel is free - a route that entered a range by a road walks on across it peak to peak and down its edge past the steep law (Mac's lag and fall).

name: OW4-J1-no-start-range
old: const mine = openBlocked && peakAt && peakAt(from.x, from.y) ? new Uint8Array(cells) : null;
note: The start's own peaks are never filled: a traveller standing among them can never leave (every step out of a peak refused).

name: OW4-J1-flood-not-filled
note: Only the start pixel itself is left freely - the first step is exempt, the next peak's is refused: a traveller deep in the peaks is stranded again.

name: OW4-J1-leaving-from-anywhere
note: A start among the peaks frees every step of the route: a road out of the traveller's range into another one is followed by a walk across that one too.

name: OW4-J1-ground-no-peaks
old: peakAt: (x, y) => climate[y * width + x] === TV_MOUNTAIN_CLIMATE,
note: The host's ground never names a peak: the start's own range is never filled, and a traveller standing among the peaks is held there.

name: OW4-J2-route-not-held
old: const route = st.route;   // AUDIT OW4 J2
new: const route = null;   // AUDIT OW4 J2
note: The route is read after the panel's Camp ended a spot's journey: the avoid roll's followPath makes it 'Following a road' or 'no path'.

name: OW4-J2-not-resumed
note: A won avoid roll on a spot's journey falls to the mod's followPath - the spot journey (and a TV8 walk) lost.

name: OW4-J3-no-whole-map-rung
note: A range wider than the 60-pixel box answers 'no way by land' again.

name: OW4-J3-rung-repeated
note: A rung the map's edges clamp to the last one's box searches the same box again (a far pick's whole-map search made twice).

name: OW4-J3-pieces-never-asked
old: if (box && !best && !asked && apart && !sea) { asked = true; if (apart(from, to, { roads, tracks })) return null; }
new: if (false) { asked = true; if (apart(from, to, { roads, tracks })) return null; }
note: A pick with no way by land searches every box to the whole map before it says so (~70-380 ms a click).

name: OW4-J3-pieces-folded-for-every-click
note: The pieces are asked before the first box: a click the first box routes pays the whole-map fold (~0.15 s) all the same.

name: OW4-J3-unentered-pixels-join
note: A pixel no step enters (a one-pixel ridge) joins the pieces either side of it, so a pick across it is searched to the whole map.

name: OW4-J3-start-neighbours-dropped
new: const mine = new Set([root[from.y * width + from.x]]);
note: A start no step enters (the shore's sea pixel) is a piece of its own: a false 'no way by land'.

name: OW4-J3-edge-back-empty
old: for (const [bit, back] of Object.entries(OPPOSITE_BIT)) BACK_BIT[Number(bit)] = back;
note: The edge back's table is empty: no step is ever a road's - every route crosses country.

name: OW4-J3-ground-read-every-click
note: The two map tables are copied and the pieces folded again at every click.

name: OW4-J4-mod-resume
note: The map's Resume walks straight from wherever the traveller is to the next leg - over the peaks after a walk by hand, a fight or a respawn.

name: OW4-J4-place-not-replanned
note: A place's Resume on the enhanced interface is the mod's straight walk again.

name: OW4-J5-ground-drive-at-rate
note: An Overworld journey with its view down (an avoided band still near) drives on the ground at the spinner's rate, ungoverned - Mac's lag.

name: OW4-J6-quad-upright

new: { center, halfW, halfH, anchor, hitFlash, conceal }, proj, view, eye, MW_ARM_PIXEL);

name: OW4-J6-mwview-no-up

name: OW4-J6-anchor-landed-upright
note: The leaned quad stands where an upright one would: the body's axis point no longer draws on itself.

new: return [anchor[0] - right[0] * px, anchor[1] - py, anchor[2] - right[2] * px];
